scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n core,notif,media,gateway,client -c blue,cyan,yellow,magenta,green "npm run dev -w services/core-service" "npm run dev -w services/notification-service" "npm run dev -w services/media-service" "npm run dev -w services/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w services/core-service && npm run build -w services/notification-service && npm run build -w services/media-service && npm run build -w services/api-gateway && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w services/core-service && npm run test -w services/notification-service && npm run test -w services/media-service
